'''Vjun moss''' were a kind of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. It had a green color with soft texture. However, lying on it for two hours would cause red welts to ooze from the skin.<ref name="dr" />
